summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in the relevance_scoring task family using linear_combination method. It computes weighted zone scores (title vs. body) via a parametric formula, which is semantically different from peer candidates (TF-IDF, IDF lookup, OOV term scoring) that operate on term weighting and statistical scoring. Existing skills are unrelated (async callbacks, reward functions). Candidate has direct support evidence from IR literature (Cambridge UP 6.1 Parametric and zone indexes) and no conflicts. This represents a new, well-defined capability.
